name: Bride Auction
source:
You are the only daughter out of the king’s one hundred heirs. Now it’s time to fulfill your duties. You are being sold off in an auction. Whoever places the highest bid before the time runs out shall be the one to claim you.

However, that’s not all. You aren’t the prize they all think you to be… You are in fact a fake set up by the king. And unluckily for you.... you are also an incomplete project. And it seems someone is willing to pay a high price to complete it.

Perhaps if you could raise your sale value to something higher… maybe then you’ll be free from their grasps? 

[From [url=https://j3nnn.itch.io/bride-auction]itch.io[/url]]
